Closes #3471

A micro after a `z` version now opens the next line instead of refusing, per new ruling R3471000 (amending R1366000):

- [patches.rs](/home/agent-muse/actions-runner-3/_work/_temp/work/item-3471/crates/tools/src/patches.rs): `versions::name_by_tier`'s `Micro` arm — `Some(b'z')` no longer bails but returns `vA.B.(C+1)` with no letter (e.g. `v0.5.12z` → `v0.5.13`), mirroring the existing Patch-after-`z` rollover. Each branch now builds its own string. Module doc's micro bullet gains the rollover sentence.
- [R3471000.md](/home/agent-muse/actions-runner-3/_work/_temp/work/item-3471/spec/rulings/R3471000.md) (new) + [pending/3471.md](/home/agent-muse/actions-runner-3/_work/_temp/work/item-3471/spec/pending/3471.md) (new): the ruling and its §11 paragraph.

- **Ruling `cards` adds R1370000** beyond the plan's list, since the text cites it (`classify --claims` fails fake claims); follows R2455000's convention of listing cited rulings.
- **Ruling motivation kept as written at refusal time** (two pending micros, one letter left) even though `v0.5.12z` has since shipped via #3469 leaving one pending fragment; the scheme gap and rule are unaffected.

## For the reviewer

- The `r3471000` ship test lives under `patches_ship_test` and uses the existing fixture helpers (`base_patch`, `unshipped`, `version_sites`, `shipped_of`, `write_fragment`, `commit_at`) with no new scaffolding.
